children: Solid Power published an updated investor presentation highlighting pilot-to-commercial electrolyte scale-up plans and $419.3M liquidity.
Published refreshed investor presentation on company website and furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K.
Plans to scale electrolyte capacity: 30 MT current pilot, 75 MT by YE 2026, 500 MT pre-commercial and target 2,000+ MT commercial.
Expect to announce a joint venture for commercial-scale electrolyte production in Korea by year-end 2026 to support market access.
Projected path to lower cost per kg with transition from batch to continuous pilot, pre-commercial and commercial volumes.
Financial position: $419.3M total liquidity as of June 30, 2026; 2026 cash investment expected $85M–$100M and no debt financing.
